title: Croatian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Croatia, featuring tender pork and a rich garlic broth.

ingredients.name: 2 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil if needed and sauté the chopped onion until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add the cubed potatoes, browned pork, stew broth, tomato paste, and paprika to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours or until pork is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
